== Title ==
<span lang="ja">潜伏</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">位置カード上にいる自分のスパイに配備する。スパイはその位置の敵側に移動する。スパイは潜伏状態となる。自分の配備フェイズにどこかの位置にいるならば、"正体を現す"ことを選択できる（このエフェクトはロストする）。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">同盟軍情報部は多大な労力を払って、帝国軍の要所にスパイを潜入させている。だがISBは執拗に狩り出しを行っているため、これらの秘密任務には常に危険がともなう</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Undercover]].

'''Lore''' — Alliance Intelligence expends great effort to place spies in key Imperial locations. Because the ISB hunts them relentlessly, these secret missions always carry danger.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on your spy at a location card. The spy moves to the opponent's side of that location. The spy becomes undercover. During your deploy phase, if it is at a location, you may choose to reveal its identity (this Effect is lost). This Effect is not affected by Alter.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese face prints immunity to Alter. The original English printed face does not. Japanese lore names key Imperial locations and ISB hunts. English names the Imperial military bureaucracy and ISB security sweeps. Japanese uses reveal identity. English uses break cover.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-undercover-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Undercover]].</ref>
